name: Media writers and readers
description: The suite's one media I/O: AVFoundation, and ImageIO through SuiteImageIO, behind SuiteModel's MediaEncoding and MediaDecoding, reached through SuiteServices.media. The rule: no app writes or reads media with its own code; new code goes through services.media, and Halo's and Photo's old copies go when their adoption moves them here. LiveMedia is the live MediaCoding and hands each call to one coder: MovieWriter writes H.264, HEVC, HEVC with alpha and ProRes 4444 movies tagged BT.709 (the canonical copy of Halo's movie writer) and deletes the file on cancel; AnimatedImageWriter writes GIF and APNG with FrameClock's delays; StillEncoder writes PNG, JPEG, HEIC and TIFF; StillDecoder decodes stills upright to 8-bit sRGB; FootageReader reads a movie's info and the exact frame at a time. Built by shell-media SM-5 to SM-9.
technology: Swift 6, AVFoundation, VideoToolbox and CoreGraphics, macOS 26
